name: Shirabe Ayumu
source:
A freelance journalist who always looks as though he needs a good night's sleep. Obsessed with the truth, he will do anything to get to it. His experiences have given him almost encyclopedic knowledge of many things, but don't expect handouts; Shirabe prefers a little give and take.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com/]official website[/url]]
